data.desc: FuelCell Energy, Inc. (Nasdaq: FCEL) is a U.S. clean-energy technology company that delivers continuous, scalable baseload power for mission-critical applications worldwide. Its fuel cell systems generate electricity on-site at the point of use, providing reliable power for data centers, industrial facilities, utilities, and distributed-generation customers. Compact and modular by design, the systems deliver quiet, low-emission power with a small footprint, while minimizing impacts on surrounding communities. FuelCell Energy provides proven utility-scale solutions for cleaner, more resilient local energy and has global deployments approaching one gigawatt. Learn more at FuelCellEnergy.com.
